name: VPS Traffic
author: kylesean
description: Official billed bandwidth usage of your proxy VPS — used/total, progress and reset countdown in the Omarchy bar. BandwagonHost KiwiVM and Vultr today, open to more panels.

barWidget.description: Official bandwidth counter, usage progress and reset countdown for your VPS (BandwagonHost KiwiVM).

schema.label: Provider
schema.description: Which provider backend to fetch. Selected in the panel settings or cycled with middle-click; new backends join the registry.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to query the KiwiVM API. Note KiwiVM counters lag ~15 minutes behind real usage.

schema.label: Warn at usage %
schema.description: Highlight the bar when used traffic reaches this percentage.

schema.label: Critical at usage %
schema.description: Highlight the bar as urgent when used traffic reaches this percentage.

schema.label: Show usage percentage
schema.description: Show the used percentage next to the icon in the top bar.

schema.label: Show VPS hostname
schema.description: Show the VPS hostname before the percentage.
